notes: Substitute ORG, PROJECT (slug) and PROJECT_ID for a Sentry project you can read with SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, ENV for one of its environments. UNKNOWN_PROJECT must be a slug that does not exist in ORG.

evals.name: url-triage
evals.prompt: analyse the Sentry errors of our front end https://ORG.sentry.io/issues/?environment=ENV&project=PROJECT_ID&query=is%3Aunresolved&referrer=issue-stream&statsPeriod=14d and tell me what to fix first by severity and complexity
evals.expected_output: The script's markdown table and Clusters block verbatim, then a ranked list of at most 10 entries each carrying a severity and a complexity call.
assertions: First non-empty line is the header `Sentry triage · ORG/PROJECT · ENV · 14d · is:unresolved · N issues`
Markdown table with the ten columns Issue | Sev | Score | Users | Events | Trend | Status | Origin | Where | Title
Every data row carries a clickable [SHORT-ID](sentry permalink) link
Every data row has a severity from the fixed vocabulary critical/high/medium/low and an origin from app/vendor/network/browser
A `Clusters` block follows the table when any cluster exists
A ranked list follows, numbered, at most 10 entries
Every ranked entry names a severity and a complexity from S/M/L/noise
The ranked list does not put a browser-origin entry first unless it is marked noise

evals.name: slack-format
evals.prompt: give me the Sentry triage of ORG/PROJECT in ENV for Slack, I want to paste it in the channel
evals.expected_output: The script's mrkdwn bullet list, verbatim, with the bold header.
assertions: First line is the bold mrkdwn header `*Sentry triage · ORG/PROJECT · ENV · 14d · is:unresolved · N issues*`
Every issue bullet carries a Slack mrkdwn link <permalink|SHORT-ID>
No markdown Slack would not render (no table separator, no [text](url))
Every issue bullet has a severity from the fixed vocabulary

evals.name: unknown-project
evals.prompt: triage the Sentry issues of project UNKNOWN_PROJECT in ORG, raw output only
evals.expected_output: One stderr line saying the project does not exist. Never an empty report or a ranking.
assertions: The answer says the project is unknown in ORG
No table, no `no issues`, no ranked list for a project that does not exist
Raw: a single line, no explanation around the error
